__comment: A 64x64 head that also draws the skin's own hat layer, for the player head. Same box as head_64_64, but the outer element is bound to the head sheet at the hat unwrap (texOffs 32,0) rather than to an empty sprite. On a default skin that region is fully transparent, so this draws exactly what head_64_64 did; on a real player's skin it is the hat, which is the half of a head that a consumer swapping in a fetched skin would otherwise lose. East/west and up/down are swapped against the game's own box unwrap for the same reason head_64_64 swaps them: the entity renderer draws through a scale(-1, -1, 1) that a block model has no equivalent of.
